info.name: AI Knowledge Assistant (Java-RAG)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the Spring Boot + Spring AI + pgvector RAG application, including Multi-Document (PDF/DOCX/TXT) ingestion, Multi-Turn conversational memory, structured summarization, and direct chat.

item.name: 1. Document Ingestion (Vector Store & Tika)
item.description: Endpoints to parse, chunk, and index documents into PostgreSQL pgvector.

formdata.description: Select any PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Markdown (.md), or Text file to upload.

request.description: Parses uploaded binary or text documents via Apache Tika, chunks them with TokenTextSplitter, computes embeddings, and stores them in pgvector with filename metadata.
Splits raw string text into token chunks and indexes them into pgvector.

item.name: 2. Multi-Turn RAG Assistant
item.description: Conversational Q&A grounded in vector search with query contextualization and chat memory.

request.description: Queries pgvector for Top-K semantic chunks and grounds the LLM answer using retrieved document context.
Tests query contextualization (pronoun resolution: 'it' -> 'Project Apollo') and multi-turn conversational memory.
Clears the server-side ChatMemory buffer for the specified conversationId.

item.name: 3. Chat & Text Intelligence
item.description: General AI endpoints without vector retrieval.

request.description: Direct conversation with the configured LLM without grounding in vector database.
Uses Spring AI structured entity extraction to return a typed JSON object: { title, summary, keyPoints }.
